Notice of Meeting and Agenda
Virtual Meeting Only

6:00p.m.
In accordance with the City of Malden Local Executive Order issued on January 4, 2022,
regarding COVID-19, this meeting shall be held remotely via technological means, in the
manner specified below (MS Teams), and no in-person attendance by members of the public is
allowed. 
All efforts will be made to permit remote public attendance of this virtual meeting via
technological means, in the manner specified below and if available, via public broadcast of the
meeting by Urban Media Arts on public access television channels.
Public access will also be provided by posting draft minutes, and/or a transcript, recording, or
recording of the meeting on the City of Malden website at www.cityofmalden.org, as soon as
practicable after the meeting.
